items.summary: No one is making music quite like PAINT, the project of musician and Allah-Las guitarist Pedrum Siadatian. If a song title can be prophetic, it's "Illusion of Voice" here, in which the vocals of real and hypothetical cast of ensemble characters and collaborators weave through a shadowy labyrinth full of twists of surrealistic transparency. From police blotter audio soundscapes to warbled poetry reads, fourth record Whip of an Ear is an obtusely captivating listen and one of the prolific musician's best offerings yet. The acts on the bill almost never sound much of anything like each other, but they always put on intense, aggressive live shows, and I always walk out feeling like I've had a great Sheetz combo meal of things that really shouldn't make sense together — some cheese curds, a breakfast burrito, maybe some sour Skittles.
